## Problem

Describe the user-visible problem and the supported Odyssey Toolkit workflow it affects.

## Change

Describe the smallest change that resolves the problem and any remaining limitation.

## Validation

- [ ] Python source compiles.
- [ ] Static release hygiene passes.
- [ ] Deterministic release build passes.
- [ ] Focused regression coverage was added or updated.
- [ ] Relevant Blender 4.5 tests were run, or the reason they were not is stated.
- [ ] No ROMFS data, extracted game assets, private paths, or generated archives are included.
- [ ] The change stays within the 1.0 stabilization scope.
